name: Alchemix USD
oneLiner: alUSD is Alchemix's self-repaying CDP stablecoin; V3 uses USDC-denominated MYT collateral, and the Transmuter settles vested alUSD into MYT.
collateral: USDC-denominated Mix-Yield Token (MYT) vault shares allocated across DAO-selected yield strategies; the V2-to-V3 migration completed in April 2026
pegMechanism: Self-repaying loans and fixed-term transmutation: vested alUSD settles at face value into an equivalent value of MYT collateral, subject to bad-debt haircuts, per-chain deposit caps, and strategy liquidity. Current documented early-exit fees apply only to unvested alAssets: 1% on Ethereum and Optimism, 2.5% on Arbitrum.

notices.title: L2 bridging deprecated and Arbitrum wind-down
notices.message: Alchemix deprecated alAsset bridging across all L2s except Optimism on October 29, 2026 following AIP-124's vote to wind down Arbitrum v3. No Arbitrum withdrawal deadline has been set; alUSD remains active on Ethereum and Optimism.
